honestBoundaries.symbolScope: This surface edits exactly one selected chord symbol. Beat-duration editing remains available through validated quick entry rather than this inspector field.
honestBoundaries.storedPitches: Keeping exact pitches does not reinterpret them against the new symbol. It records the user's explicit decision as Manual authority; the default is to discard them and recompute Automatic voicing.
honestBoundaries.webParity: Direct native symbol editing closes a release-one integration gap. It does not claim that the native app contains the web project's deeper deterministic research workbenches.
